identity_resolution: validate schema-v7, then select the unique dense candidate with the winner's exact artifact and value group; reopen its bound capacity and whole manifests to obtain the compile-matched benchmark and, for the four-role recipe, the selected-chunk planner
publication: the raw ladder uses one fresh output directory; its evaluation remains package-private until all five reports pass exact validation and fresh recomputation, then a dedicated publisher fsyncs the private regular-file inode, hard-links it without overwrite to the global authority path, verifies the published inode, revalidates all dependencies and bytes, and fsyncs the parent directory. Failure rollback removes only that observed inode; occupied names including dangling symlinks are preserved.
note: A valid P2048 result below 2000 tok/s is still published with passes_p2048_gate=false so selected-route tracing can proceed, and the runner returns nonzero so the floor remains a hard admission gate. The reported gate uses the benchmark's mean of per-repetition prompt_tokens/prefill_seconds throughput; it does not impose an inequivalent per-repeat time cutoff. No comparison candidate is run.
